purpose: One practical technical preflight card for the existing A master; supplements K01 identity/action evidence, does not add a master or shot

sourceBasis.availabilityMeaning: No newly cleared A original established in these exact records. No wider media catalogue or Prime search made; supplier availability itself is not disproven.

proposedCapture.equipmentRule: Use only already available camera, tripod, controllable diffuse light/reflector; no purchase, installation or rental
proposedCapture.preferredCapture: True2160x3840 if available and detailed; minimum target1080x1920. Do not upscale a small crop to claim native detail.
proposedCapture.colorWorkflow: Prefer known SDR/Rec709 capture or a documented known color-managed route. Do not infer clipping from unknown HDR, log, bit depth or full/limited range.
locks: manual or demonstrably locked exposure within each test window
locked white balance set with a neutral reference under the actual key light
locked focus during acting-hand and product-detail window
no automatic scene/HDR/color changes or digital beauty/AI replacement
proposedCapture.shutterQualification: 1/50 is a starting point for a50Hz-lit setup, not a flicker guarantee for this projector, LED driver, dimmer or rolling-shutter camera. Evaluate actual recordings. Compensating ISO may raise noise and must be recorded.

productSetup.key: Large diffuse key roughly45degrees to camera-left and30–45degrees above; adjust with actual hardware to preserve ribs/buttons/dome edge
productSetup.fill: Neutral white passive fill opposite if needed; taupe/cream styling stays in background, not a tint forced onto the unit
productSetup.camera: Tripod, straight product geometry; select an available optical view that keeps the whole support, hand path and cable within the existing guide, no digital zoom
productSetup.focus: Front controls and relevant support edge; test the real fingertip path before recording the master
productSetup.projectionSpill: Flag or aim key away from projection wall instead of increasing synthetic projection brightness

projectionSetup.key: Reduce or redirect only the external product key so the actual projected motif remains visible and the same unit is still readable
projectionSetup.whiteBalance: Keep the chosen neutral white-balance baseline; log any necessary actual setup change
projectionSetup.exposure: Set and lock per real setup; record values. Do not claim same exposure in different scenes if it was changed.
projectionSetup.distance: Choose actual optical focus/space on location and record camera/product/wall distances; no unverified product throw-distance claim
projectionSetup.imageTreatment: No replacement, recolouring, artificial motif sharpening or synthetic brightness comparison

preflightWindows.setup: Tripod, actual A in front, neutral static card beside it outside the projection beam, illuminated only by the external key; fixed external light and actual projector state.30fps,1/50, recorded ISO/aperture/WB.
preflightWindows.acceptance: Review the entire static5s plus frame sequence for travelling bands or periodic bright/dark pulses on the card and actual product/projection. The card measures external-light stability only when exclusively key-lit; if mixed projector/spill light reaches it, do not assign the flicker to a separate source. Do not substitute the card for the projector check.

preflightWindows.setup: Same stable arrangement and white balance,30fps,1/100; retain exposure settings or record exactly any ISO/aperture compensation to compare brightness and noise.
preflightWindows.acceptance: Choose only by actual bands, real texture, brightness and noise.1/100 or an anti-flicker toggle is not an automatic pass; if neither setting works, leave camera/light choice open.

preflightWindows.setup: Chosen recorded setting, diffuse product key; hold device still, move the real acting hand through the intended path, release and hold. No invented button function.
preflightWindows.acceptance: No focus pumping, clipped hands/support/cable, burned-out texture in body/buttons, motion smearing that prevents judging the actual action, or guide/text collisions. Inspect normal playback and100percent crop.

preflightWindows.setup: Same real A/motif traceable to K01; tripod, readable device and actual illuminated wall together, external key directed away from wall.
preflightWindows.acceptance: Motif and physical device stay identifiable, projection is not washed out by key, housing retains detail, no visible banding/pulsing or unrecorded exposure/WB drift. Record actual signal/color mode before interpreting waveform/clipping.

decisionRule: K02 technical pass requires actual originals/time windows/settings and all technical checks ERFUELLT. It never supplies K01 physical identity/motif/rights evidence by itself. K01 and K02 may be filmed in either practical order with traceable same-unit originals; no circular automatic approval. Final film/edit/mix/crop/rights/channel/ledger approvals remain separate.
